requirements.function: Represent occupant using an explicitly specified computational representation
requirements.acceptance_criterion: representation is non-null and source/provenance are present

requirements.function: Supply traceable anthropometry without guessed values
requirements.acceptance_criterion: source is explicit and validation state is closed

requirements.function: Define occupant mass/CG/inertia from authoritative inputs
requirements.acceptance_criterion: each critical field has value or explicit BLOCKED state; no guess

requirements.function: Define occupant joints and DOF
requirements.acceptance_criterion: joint definitions and DOF are complete for intended model

requirements.function: Define restraint and seat-contact interfaces
requirements.acceptance_criterion: all required interfaces are mapped and sourced

requirements.function: Define initial posture/velocity/boundary conditions
requirements.acceptance_criterion: closed with explicit source and units

requirements.function: Define load and response channels
requirements.acceptance_criterion: channel map is complete and unique

requirements.function: Provide executable sled sensor and acquisition specification
requirements.acceptance_criterion: all mandatory sensor fields are closed

requirements.function: Enforce calibration and synchronization traceability
requirements.acceptance_criterion: calibration reference and synchronization policy are explicit

requirements.function: Define accepted sled data states and provenance
requirements.acceptance_criterion: state transitions and provenance fields are machine-readable

requirements.function: Correlate FE to physical hierarchy with explicit channel mapping
requirements.acceptance_criterion: all compared channels have deterministic mappings

requirements.function: Normalize time/coordinate/sampling/filtering before metric calculation
requirements.acceptance_criterion: transform sequence is explicit and auditable

requirements.function: Compute generic correlation metrics without fabricated thresholds
requirements.acceptance_criterion: metrics are computable; threshold remains REQUIRED when unsourced

requirements.function: Generate x(t), v(t), a(t), theta(t), FL(t), FR(t) with traceable frames/signs
requirements.acceptance_criterion: each signal declares source/frame/sign/unit/time-base

requirements.function: Prevent numerical drift and coordinate/channel ambiguity
requirements.acceptance_criterion: integration/differentiation and channel identity checks exist

requirements.function: Account for energy through vehicle-to-occupant path
requirements.acceptance_criterion: all defined terms have equations/source and accounting sign

requirements.function: Detect energy imbalance without inventing a numerical result
requirements.acceptance_criterion: imbalance is calculated only from actual inputs

requirements.function: Make fault modes testable and evidence-linked
requirements.acceptance_criterion: required attributes exist; unknown ratings remain explicit

requirements.function: Deliver V4 evidence required to unlock downstream stages
requirements.acceptance_criterion: all minimum evidence classes are present and valid

requirements.function: Apply fail-closed gates
requirements.acceptance_criterion: unknown/missing/blocked/untested/assumed never evaluate PASS

requirements.function: Identify highest-priority blocker automatically
requirements.acceptance_criterion: first unsatisfied blocker in defined priority order is returned

requirements.function: Protect immutable R4.1 baseline
requirements.acceptance_criterion: actual hash equals authoritative hash and mutation false

orphan_rules: Every requirement_id must resolve to at least one function, parameter, interface, model, test, evidence, and acceptance criterion.
Every parameter/interface/model/test/evidence ID must be referenced by at least one requirement or dependency.
Unreferenced entities are ORPHAN and cause the owning readiness gate to FAIL.
